Rebuild web/dist (bun run build:web) after every web/src change.

An author's classDef/style/linkStyle paint reaches beautiful-mermaid's output as presentation attributes (fill="url(https://...)", and the escaped spelling fill="\75rl(...)"); the sanitizer drops every non-data-* attribute holding a backslash or a fetching function other than a local url(#id). Author text never reaches the <style> element (measured).
Comment threads in the Conversation are collapsed to a MarkdownPreview by default, so the spec clicks 'Expand thread' (a phone opens the Thread dialog).
A failed chunk triggers the app's existing once-per-session reload (DeploymentResilience reloadForChunkFailure); the second failure leaves the block as code.

Bundle at head: org.eclipse.elk and 'Dangling Mermaid edge' appear only in mermaid-diagrams-*.js (1,542 kB, 470 kB gzip), statically imported only by the editor chunk lib-*.js (now 201 kB, was 1,746 kB) and the lazy mermaid-svg-*.js; the entry index-*.js (757 kB) only names it in its dynamic preload list; lib-headless-*.js imports index-*, index-* and lib-remark-directive-plugin-*, none of which carries the markers.
deviations: The refusal row's source locator was fixed in its own commit 828d6894 after the change (upstream's status message quotes the dangling line, so getByText('A -->') matched two elements); the red commit ecc18ff3 is unchanged and its red run stands, since that row failed there on the status assertion before this line.

Sanitizer is stricter than the plan: besides the allowlist, on*/href removal and @import strip, it removes every non-data-* attribute holding a backslash or a fetching CSS function (url() other than url(#id), image-set, image, cross-fade, src, element), because an author's classDef/style paint reaches presentation attributes.
The closing-fence test also accepts blockquote markers before the fence (/^(?:\s*>)*\s*(`{3,}|~{3,})\s*$/), so a finished diagram quoted at the end of a body draws.

One full Dispatch unit run at head reported 2418 pass / 1 fail; the failing test name was not captured, and two reruns at the same head passed 2419/0. Recorded as an unidentified flake, not reproduced.
